listen.address.description: IP address the proxy listens on for SMTP connections (MTA → clamsmtp)

forward.address.description: IP address of the final MTA (e.g., Postfix) that receives clean mail

clamd.address.description: Path to ClamAV daemon socket (Unix) or host:port (TCP)

max_size_mb.description: Maximum message size (in megabytes) to scan; 0 = unlimited

scan_timeout.description: Maximum seconds allowed for a single message scan

clamd_timeout.description: Connection timeout to ClamAV daemon in seconds

workers.description: Number of worker processes for parallel scanning

log.file.description: Optional: absolute path to log file (if not using syslog)

action.on_infected.description: Action to take when virus is found; 'Reject' is safest

custom_virus_msg.description: Optional custom rejection message (leave empty for default)

dnsbl.rules.description: List of DNSBL checks to perform during connection

action.description: Action when IP appears in DNSBL; 'Deny' blocks, 'Warn' logs only

rate_limit.max.description: Max connections per IP in window

acl.allow.description: List of allowed client IPs/CIDR (empty = all allowed)

forward.tls.enabled.description: Use TLS when connecting to the final MTA

forward.tls.ca_file.description: Optional CA cert bundle (PEM) to verify MTA cert

forward.tls.verify.description: Require MTA cert to be valid and signed by CA

user.description: System user to run process as (security best practice)

group.description: System group to run process as
